ios.desc:
Ever feel like your own mind is your biggest obstacle? Dialed flips your mindset and helps get dialed in 60 seconds. SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED - All features require a premium subscription after your 7-day free trial. Dialed is the motivation app that personalizes cinematic speeches with inspiring music to break through procrastination, anxiety, and self-doubt, delivering the mental clarity you need to move forward. Whether you're going through hard times, need an extra push to get things done, or want some daily motivation, Dialed has you covered. 

Join thousands of users who have quieted their inner critic and found their focus.

USE DIALED TO:
- Start Your Day with a Powerful Mindset
- Calm Racing Thoughts & Everyday Stress
- Shatter Procrastination on Work, Study & Chores 
- Beat the Afternoon Slump & Regain Focus 
- Ignite Motivation for the Gym or a Home Workout 
- Build Confidence for Presentations & Important Meetings
- Overcome Self-Doubt & Build Real Confidence 
- Master Difficult Conversations with Poise 

HOW IT WORKS IN 3 SIMPLE STEPS:
1. Tell Dialed What's Blocking You: In seconds, describe your challenge—stress, fatigue, low confidence, or a specific task.
2. Receive Your Personalized Experience: Our AI instantly generates a unique, powerful speech tailored to your exact situation.
3. Feel the Shift: Our double impact system combines personalized audio and neuroscience backed focus music to change your state 

THE SCIENCE: YOUR NEUROLOGICAL ADVANTAGE 
Dialed isn't just motivation; it's a tool to command your own neurology. We use proven principles to give you an immediate edge: 
• Precision Audio: Words and speech patterns scientifically chosen to trigger confidence and focus in the brain
• Focus Music: Soundtracks calibrated to increase concentration and drive, creating the ideal mental environment

Download Dialed and take command of your mind. Today. 

Dialed requires a subscription. We offer a three day free trial of the app, then billed at your choice of $5.99/week, $12.99/month, or $39.99/year. 

Read our privacy policy: https://www.dialedmotivation.com/privacypolicy 
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text: Dialed gives you personalized pep talks when your mind is working against you. Pre-meeting, before a date, when exhausted and need to work more, before the gym... you name it. We have all these moments where our mind tends to work against us. Dialed learns what motivates you through a feedback loop and truly flips your mindset in these moments :) open to any and all feedback ofc!
